description: Use when the traveler wants to share a tracked route or a flight bucket list: a public slicktrip.com link, the same one the site's Share button makes, showing the itinerary and its price and nothing about the account. Made once and reused. To share a flights or hotels search that is not watched (a guest, or before a watch is set), use handoff_link with kind flights or hotels instead: it needs no watch and no sign-in. Never a bucket_list handoff link: it saves the list for whoever opens it.

bucket_id.description: A flight bucket list's bucket_id from list_bucket_lists.
bucket_id.title: Bucket Id

search_key.description: A tracked route's search_key from list_tracked_flights.
search_key.title: Search Key

name: share_link

route.description: Route dict with names for a tracked route

suggestions.description: On unknown_place: places to offer the traveler, each with code, name, kind (airport, all airports in the city, nearby airport), city, country
